name: [Versace Update] LensCrafters Eye Odyssey
desc:
Your Vision Tycoon is getting spooky with brand new Halloween themed stores, props and exclusive seasonal rewards.

🕸️ Discover the Halloween Collection — build new locations across your park.
👻Decorate your empire with spooky furniture and creepy-cute haunted details.
👓 Help customers find their perfect look and grow your optical business — even monsters need to see clearly!
🍬Collect limited time Halloween UGC to complete your most spook-tacular style.

Trick. Treat. Tycoon. Welcome to LensCrafters Halloween Vision Tycoon!
